definition: unhappy because you keep thinking about a problem (worried about + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: I'm really worried about my brother.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thật sự lo lắng cho em trai.

definition: used when there is a problem with someone or something (wrong with + somebody/something)
translation: có vấn đề với, bị gì
exampleSentence: What is wrong with our society? People just don't seem to care.
exampleTranslation: Xã hội của chúng ta có vấn đề gì vậy? Dường như mọi người chẳng quan tâm.

definition: having an allergy to something (allergic to + something)
exampleSentence: I'm allergic to penicillin.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dị ứng với penicillin.

definition: very surprised at something (amazed at + something)
exampleSentence: We were absolutely amazed at his rapid recovery.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi hoàn toàn kinh ngạc trước sự hồi phục nhanh chóng của anh ấy.

definition: very surprised by something (amazed by + something)
exampleSentence: She was amazed by how quickly he learned.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy kinh ngạc vì anh ấy học nhanh đến vậy.

definition: slightly angry about a situation (annoyed about + something)
exampleSentence: He was annoyed about the mistake in the bill.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy bực mình về lỗi trong hóa đơn.

definition: slightly angry with someone (annoyed with + somebody)
exampleSentence: She was annoyed with Duncan for forgetting to phone.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy bực Duncan vì quên gọi điện.

definition: very surprised about something (astonished at + something)
exampleSentence: I was astonished at the size of the crowd.
exampleTranslation: Tôi sửng sốt trước quy mô của đám đông.

definition: liking someone or something very much because you have known them for a long time (attached to + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: It's easy to become attached to the children you work with.
exampleTranslation: Rất dễ trở nên gắn bó với những đứa trẻ mà bạn làm việc cùng.

definition: able to be used or obtained by someone (available to + somebody)
exampleSentence: Not enough data is available to scientists.
exampleTranslation: Các nhà khoa học không có đủ dữ liệu.

definition: damaging or harmful to someone or something (bad for + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Smoking is bad for your health.
exampleTranslation: Hút thuốc có hại cho sức khỏe của bạn.

definition: completely failing to notice or realize something (blind to + something)
translation: mù quáng trước, không nhận ra
exampleSentence: International companies are often blind to local needs.
exampleTranslation: Các công ty quốc tế thường không nhận ra nhu cầu địa phương.

definition: working hard and having a lot of things to do (busy with + something)
exampleSentence: Mr Haynes is busy with a customer at the moment.
exampleTranslation: Hiện giờ ông Haynes đang bận tiếp một khách hàng.

definition: deliberately hurting people or animals (cruel to + somebody)
exampleSentence: She was often cruel to her sister.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy thường độc ác với em gái mình.

definition: needing someone or something in order to exist or succeed (dependent on + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Norway's economy is heavily dependent on natural resources.
exampleTranslation: Nền kinh tế Na Uy phụ thuộc nhiều vào tài nguyên thiên nhiên.

definition: giving someone or something a lot of love and attention (devoted to + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Isabella was devoted to her brother.
exampleTranslation: Isabella hết lòng yêu thương anh trai.

definition: very annoyed or upset by something unacceptable (disgusted at + something)
exampleSentence: I was disgusted at the way they treated the animals.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ghê tởm cách họ đối xử với những con vật.

definition: very annoyed or upset with someone or something unacceptable (disgusted with + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: She was disgusted with herself for lying.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy chán ghét bản thân vì đã nói dối.

definition: not satisfied because something is not as good as you expected (dissatisfied with + something)
exampleSentence: If you are dissatisfied with this product, please return it.
exampleTranslation: Nếu không hài lòng với sản phẩm này, xin vui lòng trả lại.

definition: having agreed to marry someone (engaged to + somebody)
exampleSentence: Kate is engaged to Mark.
exampleTranslation: Kate đã đính hôn với Mark.

definition: wanting something that someone else has (envious of + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Colleagues were envious of her success.
exampleTranslation: Các đồng nghiệp ghen tị với thành công của cô ấy.

definition: the same in size, number, amount or value as something else (equal to + something)
exampleSentence: The rent was equal to half his monthly income.
exampleTranslation: Tiền thuê nhà bằng một nửa thu nhập hằng tháng của anh ấy.

definition: extremely important and necessary (essential for + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: A good diet is essential for everyone.
exampleTranslation: Chế độ ăn tốt là thiết yếu đối với mọi người.

definition: not protected from something such as weather or danger (exposed to + something)
translation: phơi nhiễm với, chịu tác động của
exampleSentence: This is the side of the garden most exposed to wind.
exampleTranslation: Đây là phần của khu vườn chịu gió nhiều nhất.

definition: remaining loyal to a person, belief or promise (faithful to + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: He remained faithful to his principles to the last.
exampleTranslation: Ông ấy trung thành với nguyên tắc của mình đến cùng.

definition: extremely interested in something or someone (fascinated by + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: I was fascinated by her voice.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị cuốn hút bởi giọng nói của cô ấy.

definition: not affected by something unpleasant or controlled by someone (free from + something)
exampleSentence: Newspapers today are free from government control.
exampleTranslation: Báo chí ngày nay không chịu sự kiểm soát của chính phủ.

definition: not having or not affected by something unpleasant (free of + something/somebody)
exampleSentence: I longed to be free of my family.
exampleTranslation: Tôi khao khát thoát khỏi gia đình mình.

definition: willing to give money, time or help to someone (generous to + somebody)
exampleSentence: She is always very generous to the kids.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy luôn rất hào phóng với bọn trẻ.

definition: willing to give a lot of something such as money or time (generous with + something)
exampleSentence: Jim is very generous with his time.
exampleTranslation: Jim rất hào phóng về thời gian của mình.

definition: causing harm to someone or something (harmful to + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: These are chemicals that are harmful to the environment.
exampleTranslation: Đây là những hóa chất có hại cho môi trường.

definition: not hiding the truth or the facts about something (honest about + something)
exampleSentence: She was always very honest about her feelings.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy luôn rất trung thực về cảm xúc của mình.

definition: exactly the same, or very similar (identical to + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Infant formulas are almost identical to breast milk.
exampleTranslation: Sữa công thức gần như giống hệt sữa mẹ.

definition: suffering from a disease or not feeling well because of it (ill with + illness)
exampleSentence: Her husband has been ill with bladder trouble.
exampleTranslation: Chồng cô ấy bị bệnh về bàng quang.

definition: not owned or controlled by someone or something (independent of + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: We need a central bank that is independent of the government.
exampleTranslation: Chúng ta cần một ngân hàng trung ương độc lập với chính phủ.

definition: not guilty of a crime (innocent of + something)
exampleSentence: He is innocent of murder.
exampleTranslation: Anh ta vô tội trong vụ giết người.

definition: always supporting your friends, principles or country (loyal to + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: The army has remained loyal to the government.
exampleTranslation: Quân đội vẫn trung thành với chính phủ.

definition: angry about something; also very enthusiastic about something (mad about + something)
exampleSentence: There's no need to get mad about it!
exampleTranslation: Không cần phải nổi giận vì chuyện đó!

definition: angry with someone; mainly American English (mad at + somebody)
exampleSentence: Are you still mad at me?
exampleTranslation: Bạn vẫn còn giận tôi à?

definition: cruel or not kind to someone (mean to + somebody)
exampleSentence: Don't be so mean to her!
exampleTranslation: Đừng xấu tính với cô ấy như vậy!

definition: growing, living or produced naturally in one particular place (native to + place)
translation: có nguồn gốc bản địa ở
exampleSentence: These fish are native to North America.
exampleTranslation: Những loài cá này có nguồn gốc bản địa ở Bắc Mỹ.

definition: needed in order to have or do something (necessary for + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: A good diet is necessary for maintaining a healthy body.
exampleTranslation: Chế độ ăn tốt là cần thiết để giữ cơ thể khỏe mạnh.

definition: considering only the bad qualities of a situation or person (negative about + something/somebody)
exampleSentence: Jean rarely sounded so negative about her mother.
exampleTranslation: Jean hiếm khi nói về mẹ mình một cách tiêu cực như vậy.

definition: not experienced or known before by someone (new to + somebody)
exampleSentence: This idea was new to him.
exampleTranslation: Ý tưởng này còn mới mẻ đối với anh ấy.

definition: worried or frightened about someone or something and unable to relax (nervous of + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: We were all a bit nervous of him at first.
exampleTranslation: Lúc đầu tất cả chúng tôi đều hơi e ngại anh ta.

definition: allowing everyone, or everyone in a group, to take part or use it (open to + somebody)
exampleSentence: The competition is open to all readers in the UK.
exampleTranslation: Cuộc thi mở cho tất cả độc giả ở Anh.

definition: able to wait calmly or to accept difficulties without getting angry (patient with + somebody)
exampleSentence: Louise was very patient with me.
exampleTranslation: Louise rất kiên nhẫn với tôi.

definition: exactly what is needed for a particular purpose or person (perfect for + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: The land is perfect for sheep farming.
exampleTranslation: Vùng đất này hoàn hảo để chăn nuôi cừu.

definition: hopeful and confident about something (positive about + something)
exampleSentence: You've got to be more positive about your work.
exampleTranslation: Bạn cần tích cực hơn về công việc của mình.

definition: ready to deal with a situation (prepared for + something)
translation: chuẩn bị cho, sẵn sàng đối phó với
exampleSentence: I wasn't prepared for all their questions.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chưa chuẩn bị cho nhiều câu hỏi của họ như vậy.
